disclaimer: exploratory; not preregistered; not used for production selection
data_policy: public train only; development folds 20261126/20261127; no final evaluation

strategy_notes.top32_medoid: top-32 candidates; maximize S sum over the other 31 (self excluded)
strategy_notes.top32_prob_medoid: top-32 candidates; maximize sum_c softmax(logit)_c * S[candidate, c]
strategy_notes.top32_mean_image: softmax-weighted mean of the top-32 glyph images, binarized at 0.5
strategy_notes.pS_argmax: row softmax(T=1) over all 2748 classes times the 0-100 S matrix
strategy_notes.zlogits_plus_pS: equal-weight sum of row z-scores of logits and of pS
strategy_notes.assigned_final_ocf: official OCF after unique_assignment of the strategy's score field; for top32_mean_image the binarized image cannot be assigned, so its assigned value equals its raw value
strategy_notes.raw_top1_accuracy: null for top32_mean_image (image output, not a class index)
strategy_notes.raw_recall_at_32: null for top32_mean_image (candidate-restriction metrics do not apply)
